title: StaticCodeAnalyser Rule Catalog - Language Overlay
description: Translated rule texts for one language. The English catalog (sca-rules.json) stays canonical and complete; an overlay only carries the fields it translates, keyed by rule ID. A missing rule or a missing field falls back to English - that is a supported state, not an error, so translation can proceed rule by rule. Machine interfaces (SARIF, Sonar) always read the canonical catalog and never an overlay: their rule texts must stay stable for GitHub Code Scanning and SonarQube.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code. Must match the code used by uLocalization.SetLanguage and the i18n/*.po file names.

basedOn.description: version field of the canonical catalog this overlay was translated against. Lets a check spot translations that predate a catalog revision.

rules.description: Rule ID -> translated fields. Only fields that are actually translated; anything absent falls back to English.

name.description: Short rule title as shown in filter lists, the HTML report and the IDE panel.

shortDescription.description: One-line summary. Same 200-character ceiling as the canonical catalog.

fullDescription.description: Full prose. Deliberately NOT translated in the first pass: it is roughly ten times the volume of name+shortDescription and ages fastest. English fallback is the documented behaviour.
